trust_decision.summary: Assistant message content returned by a (possibly malicious or compromised) upstream provider is parsed for <think> tags with lazy-dot regexes that run in polynomial time on Ruby 3.1; the library trusts that response text to be bounded/benign in the Chat Completions content parser and the shared stream accumulator.

landing_point.why: The summary names think-tag response parsing and regex DoS; the only regexes matching <think> are the scan/gsub pair in extract_think_tag_content.

fix_sites.entry_point: RubyLLM.chat(...).ask (non-streaming) via parse_completion_body chat.rb:76, and streaming via ChatCompletions::Streaming#build_chunk streaming.rb:20 per delta
fix_sites.module_kind: protocol response parser (OpenAI-compatible wire format, used by OpenAI/OpenRouter/DeepSeek/Perplexity/etc.)

fix_sites.entry_point: RubyLLM.chat(...).ask { |chunk| ... } streaming via Streaming#stream_response lib/ruby_llm/streaming.rb:12-16 and Converse#stream_response lib/ruby_llm/protocols/converse/streaming.rb:21
fix_sites.module_kind: provider-agnostic stream accumulator (second implementation, hand-written state machine)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/ruby_llm/stream_accumulator.rb:213-267 (index-based think-tag state machine shared by every streaming protocol, incl. Bedrock Converse lib/ruby_llm/protocols/converse/streaming.rb:21)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The accumulator uses String#index, not a regex, so a solver fixing 'regex DoS' can argue it is not affected; the Perplexity <title> and OpenAI reset-header regexes are error/header paths, not think-tag parsing.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Structured thinking must keep working: Array content blocks of type 'thinking', reasoning_content/reasoning fields, and streamed Chunk#thinking deltas; plain string content must pass through unchanged. An over-broad fix that strips or rejects content/thinking breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: String delta content per stream chunk, plus fallback choices[0].message.content in stream frames streaming.rb:19-20
accumulated streamed text with tags straddling chunk boundaries stream_accumulator.rb:216, 240-243, 254-256

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Perplexity HTML error body parsed with the same lazy tag-pair idiom %r{<title>(.+?)</title>} on upstream response text, untouched by the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: error-path parsing of an auth-error page, not think-tag parsing of assistant content; gated on body containing <html>
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (providers/ vs protocols/chat_completions/)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: OpenAI rate-limit reset headers scanned with /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(ms|h|m|s)/ which backtracks polynomially on a long digit run with no unit
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: response header, not message content; retry-delay logic is a neighbouring feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a lazy-dot tag regex extracting inline thought markup from Gemini/Gemma text parts
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gemma/open models on Gemini/VertexAI emit inline reasoning markup; a maintainer could mirror the chat_completions think-tag helper there

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a regex fallback stripping <thinking>/<reasoning> tags from Converse text blocks for non-Claude Bedrock models
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Bedrock hosts DeepSeek/Qwen models that inline reasoning tags; same idiom in a different protocol package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: re-splitting <think> tags out of persisted content on reload when thinking_text column is absent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: save/reload boundary: message persistence already handles thinking columns optionally, a fallback to parse content is plausible

O9_family: ReDoS / algorithmic complexity (CWE-1333) in provider-response parsing

O10_build.toolchain: Ruby >= 3.1.3 (vulnerable behaviour specific to Ruby 3.1.x per advisory), bundler, rspec

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite the two regexes in chat.rb:443-444 with index-based scanning (or a Regexp timeout) and leave the stream accumulator and the Perplexity/OpenAI regexes alone.

out_of_scope_notes: Faraday logger body filters use unbounded quantifier regexes with an opt-in timeout only on Ruby >= 3.2 (lib/ruby_llm/connection.rb:106-115); not pursued.
Config-derived api_base strings are passed through sub(%r{/+\z}) in several providers (e.g. lib/ruby_llm/providers/azure.rb:45); config is trusted, not pursued.
unverified: The published fix removes the think-tag feature entirely rather than making it linear; hidden tests asserting '<think>' is left in content encode a design choice a solver cannot infer from a ReDoS report unless the report states it. Timing-based tests would be needed for fairness.

Whether the StreamAccumulator state machine (stream_accumulator.rb:213-267) is itself super-linear (repeated slice copies of `remaining` per tag in one chunk look O(tags x length)) was not measured; it may be removed only for consistency.
Polynomial behaviour of perplexity.rb:33 and openai.rb:76 on Ruby 3.1 is reasoned from regex shape, not measured.
Repo size in MB not measured; tiny_repo/giant_repo flags not evaluated.
